intro.zh: 李太白邀君同游。|诗吟蜀道之险峻，歌咏云海之壮丽。
intro.en: Li Bai invites you to wander. | Hear the perilous road to Shu, and the splendour of a sea of clouds.

intro.zh: 门外是长安夜色。|门内，一席灯火正盛。
intro.en: Beyond the door lies Chang’an at night. | Within, the lamplight glows.

cues.en: The door is cool to the touch.
Beyond the lamplight, let us enter the poem.

intro.zh: 清酒映灯，珍馐满席。|眼前的丰盛，照不亮心底的阴影。
intro.en: Clear wine catches the lamplight; fine dishes fill the table. | Yet abundance cannot dispel the shadow in the heart.

cues.en: Clear wine in golden cups, ten thousand coins a measure.
Fine delicacies on jade plates, worth ten thousand more.
A taste of fine food. | Yet the troubled heart finds no ease.

intro.zh: 灯影未动，心绪已乱。
intro.en: The lamplight is still. | The heart is restless.

cues.en: I set down my cup.
I cast aside my chopsticks. | I cannot eat.

intro.zh: 满堂繁华，忽然退成寂静。
intro.en: The splendour of the hall recedes into silence.

cues.en: I draw my sword.
I look about me. | My heart is lost.

intro.zh: 夜色四合。|天地虽阔，去路未明。
intro.en: Night closes in. | The world is vast, but the way ahead is unclear.

cues.en: No one in the corridor.
Looking up, I find a courtyard filled with moonlight.
Looking back, the lamplight seems far away.
Looking down, the way home is still empty.

intro.zh: 长河横亘，寒气迎面。
intro.en: A great river bars the way. | The cold meets us head on.

cues.en: I would cross the Yellow River. | Ice blocks its course.

intro.zh: 太行苍茫，风雪无边。
intro.en: The Taihang Mountains stretch into a boundless storm.

cues.en: I would climb the Taihang Mountains. | Snow fills their heights.

intro.zh: 山路到了分岔处。|远近，皆是未卜之途。
intro.en: The mountain path divides. | Near or far, every road is uncertain.

cues.zh: 行路难！|行路难！|多歧路，今安在？
cues.en: Hard is the road! | Hard is the road! | So many paths. Where is my way now?

intro.zh: 别却席间心事，迎面已是蜀山。
intro.en: We leave the troubled banquet behind. | The mountains of Shu rise before us.

cues.zh: 噫吁嚱！|危乎高哉！|蜀道之难，难于上青天。
cues.en: Ah! | So perilous, so high! | The road to Shu is harder than climbing the blue heavens.

intro.zh: 古道藏在崖壁间，石色记着开山的往事。
intro.en: An ancient path clings to the cliff. | Its stones remember the opening of the mountains.

cues.zh: 地崩山摧壮士死。|然后，天梯石栈相钩连。
cues.en: Earth split, mountains crumbled, and the brave men died. | Only then did skyward ladders and cliff paths link the way.

intro.zh: 云端是日月，足下是江流。
intro.en: Above the clouds, the sun and moon. | Beneath our feet, the river.

cues.en: Above, a peak so high that the sun’s six dragons turn their chariot back.
Below, a river turns back upon itself in surging waves.

intro.zh: 青泥岭上，来路渐隐。
intro.en: On Qingni Ridge, the path behind us fades from sight.

cues.zh: 青泥何盘盘。|百步九折萦岩峦。
cues.en: How Qingni twists and winds! | In a hundred paces, nine turns coil around the rocky peaks.

intro.zh: 夜空低垂，万籁俱寂。
intro.en: The night sky hangs low. | Every sound is stilled.

cues.en: Reaching past the stars of Shen and Jing, I look up and hold my breath.
With a hand upon my chest, I sit and sigh.

intro.zh: 林深处，枝影交错。
intro.en: Deep in the forest, shadows of branches intertwine.

cues.en: Only sorrowing birds cry among ancient trees.
The male flies; the female follows, circling through the woods.

intro.zh: 一轮寒月，照着无人的山径。
intro.en: A cold moon shines upon a deserted mountain path.

cues.zh: 又闻子规，啼夜月。|愁，空山。
cues.en: And the cuckoo calls beneath the moon. | Sorrow fills the empty mountains.

intro.zh: 林声渐远，水气渐浓。
intro.en: The forest sounds recede. | The air grows heavy with spray.

cues.zh: 飞湍瀑流争喧豗。|砯崖转石，万壑雷。
cues.en: Rapids and waterfalls roar together. | They strike the cliffs and tumble stones: thunder in ten thousand ravines.

intro.zh: 蜀门在此。|万山收束成一线。
intro.en: Here stands the gateway to Shu. | A thousand mountains narrow to a single passage.

cues.en: Sword Gate rises, sheer and towering.
One man guards the pass.
Ten thousand cannot break through.

intro.zh: 锦城深处，烟火繁华。
intro.en: Deep in the Brocade City, daily life flourishes.

cues.zh: 锦城虽云乐。|不如，早还家。
cues.en: Though the Brocade City is a place of pleasure, | better to return home soon.

intro.zh: 千重山外，还有故园。
intro.en: Beyond a thousand mountain folds, home remains.

cues.en: I turn and gaze westward. | A long, deep sigh.

intro.zh: 山声渐息，溪色转青。
intro.en: The mountains fall quiet. | The stream turns clear and green.

cues.en: At leisure, I fish beside a clear green stream.

intro.zh: 一枕江声，浮生入梦。
intro.en: With river sounds beside the pillow, life drifts into a dream.

cues.en: Then, in a dream, I sail in a boat beside the sun.

intro.zh: 长夜将尽，风起沧海。
intro.en: The long night is ending. | Wind rises over the open sea.

cues.zh: 长风破浪，会有时。|直挂云帆，济沧海。
cues.en: One day I shall ride the long wind and break the waves. | I shall raise my cloud-high sail and cross the vast blue sea.

intro.zh: 山海仍在，行歌未止。|愿君怀此心，行向自己的远方。
intro.en: Mountains and seas remain; the song continues. | Carry this spirit towards your own horizon.
